runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game nf_23x --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-security/nf-underground-trough-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Built-in mechanisms stay disabled, so the host plays the ball: it loads the trough, releases trough 4 after the eject, closes the shooter lane until the auto plunger fires, and pulses the underground trough switches in the order a ball passes them.

named_action_observations.label: T.18 UNDERGROUND TROUGH TEST starts in MANUAL and pulses public 8 (drop target down) repeatedly; closing the left trough entrance 38 pulses 8 again
In MANUAL the display marks LEFT ENTR., CTR. ENTR., POPPER 2 and POPPER 1 while host public 38, 37, 42 and 41 are 1; 37, 42 and 41 fire nothing
Switched to AUTOMATIC with the trough loaded (32-35 at public 1), the ROM fires the trough eject, public 14, and holds it until trough 4 (35) opens
With the shooter lane switch 15 closed the ROM fires the auto plunger, public 2, and drops it when 15 opens

After the left (38) and centre (37) trough entrances and right popper opto 2 (42) are pulsed, holding right popper opto 1 (41) makes the ROM fire the right popper, public 1, until 41 opens; it then fires the trough eject 14 for the next ball

raw_runs.name: nf_23x-underground-trough-test
raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, so the ROM restored its factory settings before the scenario left the message loop with Escape

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
